purpose: Stabilize semantic dialogue, response ownership and hidden global optimization across a fresh run by changing information ownership and writer-visible abstraction level rather than adding surface prose rules.

semantic_live_vector.validation_role: Used only to compile concrete affordances and to evaluate reader-drive after generation.

causal_event_compiler.output: writer-visible concrete state packet plus pre-owned non-focal causal event cards

focal_concrete_state: factual exit plan without abstract relationship thesis

properties: anchored to that actor's own task or environment change
contains observable action and at most one bounded public fact payload
not created in response to writer-generated dialogue
non_focal_causal_event_cards.renderer_authority: Renderer may choose wording and may omit a non-required card, but may not invent an additional information-bearing non-focal response.

response_surface_contract.rule: Phase405 must reuse the Phase404 positive closed response-surface transaction without expansion.

audit_rules: BLOCK if abstract live-vector question/cost/desired-state summaries remain writer-visible.
BLOCK if non-focal information-bearing speech remains renderer-inventable without a pre-owned causal event card.
BLOCK if a causal event card is triggered by or formulated as a response to focal dialogue.
BLOCK if Phase404 response transaction is altered or expanded.
BLOCK if dialogue/question/paragraph/summary quotas are introduced.
BLOCK if best-of-N, retry, A2 or second window is introduced.
